summary: Integra Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release updating progress at its DeLamar gold-silver project in Idaho. The filing covers detailed engineering, permitting, procurement and state-of-good-repairs work, and names GenCap as project financing advisor. The December 2025 feasibility study cited ~US$389M initial capital, US$774M after-tax NPV and 46% IRR at US$3,000/oz gold and US$35/oz silver, with a final investment decision expected after the EIS and Record of Decision in H2 2027. No securities transaction or special situation is present; this is a routine operational update.
